{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data and inspect more carefully
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check column names again
print('Column names:', trial_df.columns.tolist())

# The column is 'responded', not 'response'
print('\nResponded values and counts:')
print(trial_df['responded'].value_counts(dropna=False))

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker data
print('\nBiomarker baseline sentinel values:')
print(trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].unique())

print('\nBiomarker final sentinel values:')
print(trial_df['biomarker_final'].unique())

# Check if 'responded' is binary
print('\nUnique values in responded:')
print(trial_df['responded'].unique())"}
